summary: Full end-to-end validation of the NEW VOD-record engine + delete CRUD, both backend (pytest 12 tests, 11 passed / 1 skipped) and frontend (Playwright, headless, 1920x1080). REBUILT /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from scratch to reflect the major engine change (previous suite still referenced 'ludwig' demo seed etc.). Backend verified against https://twitch-highlight-bot.preview.emergentagent.com/api: (a) GET /channels -> xqc/kaicenat/pokimane all with is_demo=false and no _id leak; (b) xqc clips are genuinely VOD-recorded — source_type='vod', twitch_clip_id starts with 'vod-<id>-<offset>', embed_url IS empty (proves NOT Twitch pre-made clips), duration in 18-45s, start_seconds numeric, vod_id present, ai_title+ai_hashtags(list, all '#…')+ai_caption+render_status all present; sort is created_at desc; (c) POST /channels/{kai}/sync body={period_days:30} after clearing kaicenat returned fetched=5 stored=24 with the same shape; (d) GET /clips?channel_id=xqc filters correctly; (e) GET /clips/{id}/thumb -> 200 image/jpeg (poster served for rendered clips); (f) POST /clips/{id}/prepare -> 200 {render_status:'rendering'|'done'|'pending'}, unknown -> 404; (g) GET /clips/{id}/video (after prepare-then-poll-done to bypass CF 100s edge timeout) -> 200 video/mp4, Content-Disposition:attachment, body ffprobed as h264 1080x1920 — THE core deliverable; unknown -> 404; (h) DELETE /clips/{id} removes exactly that clip (verified via re-GET); (i) DELETE /clips?channel_id={pok} deleted only pokimane's clips, xqc untouched; (j) DELETE /clips (no filter) deleted all with {deleted:N} where N>=total_before (small drift tolerated because auto_sync_loop/render_worker can insert concurrently). Frontend verified: dashboard loads, 3 channels in sidebar, 72 clip cards across All Channels (24/24/24 before deletes). Every card shows: hype badge (Creepy Moment, Hype Spike, Laughter, Wholesome, Fail, Insane Play…), AI title with emoji, 6-9 hashtags, 'from past broadcast @ h:mm:ss' timestamp, game name, 9:16 poster thumbnail, and a green 'Preparing…' (data-testid=download-clip-button-<id>) — rendered clips show 'Save video' variant. Per-card delete (data-testid=delete-clip-button-<id>) on a pokimane card -> card immediately disappears from grid. Per-channel delete (data-testid=delete-channel-clips-button-2e4bf3a5-fa1e-4823-997f-9497a13fc228) on KaiCenat -> 'Deleted 24 clips' toast + KaiCenat panel switches to empty-state 'No clips yet. Recording the best hype moments from past broadcasts…' and All Channels count drops from 71 to 47. Top-bar Delete-all button (data-testid=delete-all-clips-button) is present. clip-play-button-<id> present on 47 rendered clips; clip-video-player-<id> selectors also confirmed in DOM.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sync_clips uses `need = max(limit - existing, limit)` which ALWAYS asks _store_vod_clips for a full `limit` batch (24) even when 24 are already stored — mostly benign because _store_vod_clips dedupes on twitch_clip_id 'vod-<id>-<offset>', but it costs GQL calls and CPU. Consider `need = max(limit - existing, 0)` for a fast-return.

delete_all_clips has no auth and no confirmation on the server — the app is intentionally open-access, but this endpoint can wipe every clip via a single unauthenticated DELETE. Frontend guards with window.confirm; consider adding a lightweight ?confirm=true query gate on the API side to prevent accidental curl.
get_clip_video still reads the whole rendered mp4 into memory (~30MB for 45s clips). Streaming with pre-computed Content-Length would be safer for longer VOD-sourced clips.
render_worker uses os.getloadavg()[0] threshold — in a container this reads host load, not the pod's own; on a busy node it back-offs unnecessarily (unchanged prior comment).

sync_clips returns fetched=5 stored=0 when the channel already has all deduped VOD moments — currently the frontend swallows this silently; UX would improve if the response was flagged (e.g., 'up_to_date':true) so the UI can toast 'already have latest clips' rather than doing nothing visible.

ClipCard.jsx uses SAME data-testid=download-clip-button-<id> for both 'Preparing…' and 'Save video' — good for automation but the only affordance is the label change; an aria-live announcement would improve a11y (unchanged prior comment).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical delete + card render flows verified)

test_credentials: N/A — open access, no login required
seed_data_creation: Pre-existing 3 real channels xqc/kaicenat/pokimane are pre-seeded. During tests kaicenat & pokimane were cleared and re-synced from Twitch VODs; after run, re-populated all three via POST /channels/{id}/sync {period_days:30} so next agent has 24/24/24 clips.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real (non-demo) channels are pre-seeded and IDs are fixed: xqc=476dc540-1e59-4e60-baee-ee6395832863, kaicenat=2e4bf3a5-fa1e-4823-997f-9497a13fc228, pokimane=a9defff4-626f-429f-a606-fcc8f5c788cd. POST /channels/{id}/sync REQUIRES a JSON body {period_days:int}, else 422. To test /clips/{id}/video without hitting Cloudflare 100s edge timeout: call POST /clips/{id}/prepare, then poll GET /clips/{id} until render_status='done', THEN GET /video (returns instantly from cache). Delete-all is destructive AND will re-sync xqc/kai/pok in test_z_delete_all_clips fixture — no manual cleanup needed but run backend suite serially with `-n 0` (loadscope xdist would race the destructive test).
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved bugs. Only minor cleanup findings above.
